# China Hospitals Guide

> An independent medical tourism resource helping international patients find JCI-accredited hospitals in China — surgery costs, hospital rankings, and a 3-tier hospital matching service ($49–$399).

China Hospitals Guide (chinahospitalsguide.com) publishes research-based guides on medical treatment costs, hospital rankings, and practical advice for international patients seeking affordable healthcare in China. All content is written and updated by the founder, a medical tourism consultant with deep knowledge of China's Fudan University hospital ranking system, JCI accreditation, medical visa processes, and real surgery pricing across 40+ specialties. We are not affiliated with any hospital and take 0% commission — our recommendations are based on your medical needs, not kickbacks. Data is refreshed as new Fudan rankings and pricing surveys are released.

## Core Guides — Surgery Costs & Hospital Rankings

- [LASIK Eye Surgery in China 2026](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/lasik-eye-surgery-china-2026.html): Costs ($800–$1,500/eye vs $3,000+ US), SMILE vs Femto-LASIK vs ICL, top 10 eye hospitals, safety, and recovery timeline.
- [Plastic Surgery in China 2026](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/plastic-surgery-china-guide-2026.html): Beijing liposuction $1,500–$3,000/area, rhinoplasty, double eyelid, breast augmentation costs. Top hospitals in Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou.
- [China Hospital Rankings 2026](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/china-hospital-rankings-2026.html): Complete Fudan University rankings — A++++ elite tier, top 10 by specialty (orthopedics, cardiology, oncology, neurosurgery), and hospitals by city.
- [Cataract Surgery in China](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/cataract-surgery-china.html): IOL types, costs ($1,500–$3,000/eye), and top eye hospitals for cataract surgery.
- [Hair Transplant in China 2026](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/hair-transplant-china-2026.html): FUE vs DHI, cost per graft ($0.80–$2.50), and best clinics.
- [Breast Augmentation in China 2026](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/breast-augmentation-china-2026.html): Costs ($4,000–$7,000), implant types, and top hospitals.

## Procedure Cost Comparisons — China vs USA

- [Knee Replacement Cost](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/knee-replacement-cost-china.html): $8,000–$12,000 in China vs $35,000+ US.
- [Hip Replacement Cost](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/hip-replacement-cost-china.html): $8,000–$12,000 in China vs $35,000+ US.
- [Heart Surgery Cost](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/heart-surgery-cost-china.html): Bypass $18,000–$25,000 in China vs $120,000+ US.
- [Spine Surgery Cost](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/blog/spine-surgery-cost-china.html): $15,000–$22,000 in China vs $80,000+ US.
- [Full Cost Comparison](https://chinahospitalsguide.com/cost-comparison.html): Across all major procedures.
